title: Recipes that make money at a vendor
summary: VendorPrinter lists the recipes you can craft and sell to a vendor for more than the reagents cost, then builds a shopping list.

steps.say: The Vendor tab lists every recipe you know that sells to a vendor for more than its reagents cost. Best profit first.
Cost is the cheapest way to buy the reagents: from a vendor or the Auction House, whichever is lower.
Profit % is the profit as a share of the cost: what you make on every copper you put in.
Hover a recipe to see each reagent, what it costs and where to buy it.
Qty sets how many crafts the shopping list is for.
Click a recipe: its Cooking window opens on that recipe, and a shopping list for 20 crafts goes to chat.

expect.chat: Shopping list for 20x Longjaw Mud Snapper

steps.say: The shopping list is in the chat window, grouped by vendor and Auction House.
